new.content:
Ryan Serhant is a real estate broker, founder of SERHANT., and star of Bravo’s  Million Dollar Listing New York  and Netflix’s  Owning Manhattan . 



 Public Release: October 8.  Members have  access now .   Join us  . 



 He explains how to sell without making people feel sold to: build a connection, help first, and earn the right to ask. He also breaks down the psychology of attention and persuasion, showing how to get people’s attention, hold it, and turn it into business. 



 We explore why he rejects “fake it till you make it,” how he approached his Million Dollar Listing audition as the person he wanted to become, and why ego gets in the way of closing deals. 



 Ryan explains his time management framework of treating each day as a bank of 1,000 minutes changed the way he works, and why success can still feel insufficient after you achieve all of your dreams.  



  Coming Soon: YouTube |  Spotify   |  Apple Podcasts |  Transcript

new.title: Most Replayed Moment: AI Is Changing How Teams Work Forever
new.summary:
AI At Work: Mass Unemployment Or A New Era Of Human Potential?





Nick Hanauer is a billionaire entrepreneur, venture capitalist and outspoken advocate for a more inclusive economy. Daniel Priestley is a bestselling author, entrepreneur and co-founder of multiple businesses helping people build and scale companies.





In this moment, Nick Hanauer and Daniel Priestley debate one of the biggest questions facing the future of work: what happens when AI can do more of the tasks we once thought only humans could perform? They explore the uncertainty ahead, the unexpected opportunities emerging, and why the way we think about jobs, businesses and value creation may be about to change for good.
